text.zh-TW: 奇怪……剛才明明還看得到路。
text.en-GB: That’s strange… I could see the path just a moment ago.

direction.zh-TW: natural question to Shui; not afraid
direction.en-GB: natural question to Shui; not afraid

text.zh-TW: 小水，你還記得我們是從哪邊進來的嗎？
text.en-GB: Shui, do you remember which way we came in?

text.zh-TW: 不對，剛剛這裡明明只有一條路。
text.en-GB: Wait. There was only one path here before.

text.zh-TW: 眼睛看見的，就一定是真的嗎？
text.en-GB: Can you trust everything you see?

text.zh-TW: 如果連方向都分不清……又怎麼走得出迷霧森林？
text.en-GB: If you can’t even tell which way to go… how will you ever escape the Misty Forest?

text.zh-TW: 左邊的大樹、右邊的石頭……只要記清楚，就不會走錯。
text.en-GB: Big tree on the left, rock on the right… If I remember them, I won’t get lost.

text.zh-TW: 記得越清楚，就一定越接近答案嗎？
text.en-GB: Does remembering more always bring you closer to the answer?
No… this one isn’t right either.

text.zh-TW: 樹會變，路會變……連我的影子都會變。
text.en-GB: The trees change. The paths change… Even my own shadow can change.
But you’ve been right here all along.

text.zh-TW: 我只是知道，什麼才值得相信。
text.en-GB: I just know what’s worth trusting now.

text.zh-TW: 哦？不再相信自己的眼睛了嗎？
text.en-GB: Oh? You don’t trust your own eyes anymore?
Seeing through an illusion is only the first step.

text.zh-TW: 接下來，讓我看看你的判斷……是不是也一樣可靠。
text.en-GB: Now let’s see whether your judgement is just as reliable.

text.zh-TW: 看來這次，迷霧也騙不到你們了。
text.en-GB: Looks like the mist can’t fool you anymore.
Wow! The mist really is clearing!
I never knew it was this beautiful!
Huh? There are two fruits here.

direction.zh-TW: curious, clear pause between black and white
direction.en-GB: curious, clear pause between black and white

text.zh-TW: 一顆黑色的……一顆白色的？

text.en-GB: Come on, Shui. Let’s go and see!
The mist can fool your eyes.

text.zh-TW: 小水，我們再多練習一下吧。
text.en-GB: Shui, let’s practise a little more.
